title: Local and Global Variables
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of local and global variables.
Apply local and global variables in a small Python example or interpret a representative result.
Identify one limitation, edge case, compatibility concern, or failure mode relevant to the topic.

content.intro: This lesson introduces local and global variables as part of python functions. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: The key is to connect syntax to the value or behavior it produces. Start with a small expression, predict its result, and then verify it in the interpreter.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A name refers to an object; assignment binds or rebinds a name rather than creating a typed storage box.

content_blocks.text: For local and global variables, identify the inputs and assumptions first.
